en.headline: Police arrest 58 including 10 students in anti-triad operation targeting youth
en.dek: Officers said triad groups had lured teenagers with promises of quick money into drug trafficking, wounding and other crimes.
body: Police arrested 58 people, including 10 students and 13 minors, in an anti-triad operation codenamed Speedy Wheels that began on Thursday.

Chief Inspector Chan Pak-ki of the Organized Crime and Triad Bureau said officers had noted a rise in youth crime since the start of the year. Undercover officers infiltrated two triad societies and found that groups were recruiting teenagers with simple initiation rites and promises of quick money, then directing them to take part in criminal damage, drug trafficking, wounding and money laundering.

In the operation, officers raided multiple locations across Kowloon and the New Territories. They arrested 49 men and nine women aged between 14 and 73 on suspicion of offences including claiming to be triad members, conspiracy to wound, criminal intimidation, money laundering, possession of offensive weapons and trafficking in dangerous drugs. Twenty-one of those arrested have triad backgrounds. Officers also disrupted several illegal gambling dens and drug dens.
Police said the operation would continue and further arrests had not been ruled out. They urged young people not to believe false promises of easy money that could lead them into illegal activities.

zh.headline: 警方反三合會行動拘58人 包括10名學生
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科指，黑幫以揺快錢為餌誘騙青少年參與販毒傷人等罪行。
body: 警方於周四展開代號「飲輪」的反三合會行動，共拘58人，當中包括10名學生及13名未成年人士。
有組織罪案及三合會調查科總督察陳柏琪表示，警方自今年初留意到青少年犯罪上升，遂派探員喬裝滲透兩個三合會社團。調查發現，社團以簡單入會儀式及「揺快錢」承諾誘騙青少年，再指使他們參與刑事毀壞、販毒、傷人及洗黑錢等活動。
行動中，警方突擊搜查九龍及新界多個地點，以自稱三合會成員、串謀傷人、刑事恐嚇、洗黑錢、藏有攻擊性武器及販運危險藥物等罪，拘49男9女，年齡介乎14至73歲。其中21人有三合會背景。警方同時搗破多個非法賭場及毒窟。
警方表示行動會繼續，不排除再有人被捕，並提醒青少年不要輕信「揺快錢」的虛假承諾，以免被誘使犯法。
